st_liens.name: Passage des Prises
st_liens.alt: A sunny park pond crossed by an arched wooden footbridge with an iron lamp post, stepping stones in the shallows, a big tree with a lantern and a socket on its trunk and a little café table on the grass; a rose-covered trellis arch stands on the left and a white garden gate in the hedge on the right. Monsieur Verbe, crampons on his boots, clings to the lamp post holding his hand mirror; mends a teacup with his magic wand in a gold beret; plugs a cable into the tree so the lantern lights up; lays a plank across the stepping stones for the duck; waves at a video call on his laptop at the café table; and bows as a butler with a tray of invitations. The stone path at the bottom leads back to the park.

doors.label: Rue des Colocataires
doors.hint: Through the white garden gate in the hedge

lambris.name: Allée des Lambris
lambris.alt: The lake shore beside a wood-paneled boathouse, with a bare earth mound, an artist's easel, a rope spider web strung between two posts, an old tree stump and a row of cardboard boxes: Monsieur Verbe waters a sapling with a friendly snake coiled round it; points at his own black paper profile on the easel; sets the spider in the center of its web; and opens box after box while the dog finds a bone in each. The rose-covered trellis arch leads back.

doors.label: Passage des Prises
doors.hint: Back through the rose-covered trellis arch

colocataires.name: Rue des Colocataires
colocataires.alt: A sandy lake shore with a sailboat on the water, a sand mound, a souvenir stall with a striped awning and a row of colorful beach huts: Monsieur Verbe kneels by the white garden gate joining two copper pipes with a cord; stands on the mound with a parrot on his finger, mouth in a round O; carries a log with a beaver in a red collar; waves from a beach hut door while a cow looks out of the window and a bee sits on the roof; hands bread from his stall to the duck family in a gold beret; and gazes into his hand mirror with a prawn on his shoulder and hearts floating up, in a gold beret. The white garden gate leads back.

doors.label: Passage des Prises
doors.hint: Back through the white garden gate
